programs.name: Campus Software Engineer (Intern)

source.note: jumptrading.com wrapper page is JS-rendered/403 to plain fetch; content read via Greenhouse ATS static endpoints (boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/jumptrading/jobs/8002989 and job-boards.greenhouse.io/embed/job_app?for=jumptrading&token=8002989), which serve the same posting. Audience marked 'all' because posting states no class-year restriction. Posting describes a 10-week internship that 'is the primary way we identify top young software engineers' and 'a proven path for earning full-time opportunities at Jump' (per content read).

sponsorship.quote: INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS are encouraged to apply. We accept students eligible for CPT/OPT and we sponsor work visas for full-time positions

compensation.quote: The estimated base salary for this role is $250,000 per year.

cooling_off.notes: Posting content read in full via Greenhouse API: no reapplication, retake, or waiting-period language. IMPORTANT LIMIT: jumptrading.com HR pages that would carry a firm-wide FAQ (https://www.jumptrading.com/hr/students-new-grads and https://www.jumptrading.com/hr/overview) returned HTTP 403 to fetch, so firm-site-wide silence is unverified — only the ATS posting text is confirmed silent.
